squad.title: Squad recap
squad.lead: Enter two to five Riot IDs from the same server. We look at the games you played together and hand out the awards.
squad.fine: Works best with people you queue with, since it only looks at shared games. <link>See a sample squad</link>

clash.title: Squad vs squad
clash.lead: Two squads of two to five, from the same server. We look at the games where you played against each other, like a custom 5v5.
clash.fine: Only counts games with at least two of each squad on opposite teams. <link>See a sample clash</link>

versus.title: Head-to-head
versus.lead: Pick two players and see who comes out ahead: stat by stat, style by style, and how you do when you queue together.
versus.fine: Compares each player's latest games. <link>See a sample matchup</link>
